p1:
posIn     = input.string("Bottom Right", "Panel position", options=["Bottom Right", "Middle Right", "Top Right", "Top Center", "Bottom Center", "Top Left", "Bottom Left"], group="Display", tooltip="Pick a corner no other indicator uses - two tables in the same corner draw on top of each other")
szIn      = input.string("Normal", "Panel text size", options=["Small", "Normal", "Large"], group="Display")

txtSz = szIn == "Small" ? size.small : szIn == "Large" ? size.large : size.normal
pos   = switch posIn
    "Middle Right"  => position.middle_right
    "Top Right"     => position.top_right
    "Top Center"    => position.top_center
    "Bottom Center" => position.bottom_center
    "Top Left"      => position.top_left
    "Bottom Left"   => position.bottom_left
    => position.bottom_right
p2:
// solid colours only (transparency 0) so candles and lines never show through the text
cBg   = color.new(#0b0f19, 0)
cLbl  = color.new(#141a2b, 0)
cLblT = color.new(#aab4c8, 0)
cTxt  = color.new(#ffffff, 0)
cUp   = color.new(#00e676, 0)
cDn   = color.new(#ff5252, 0)
cMid  = color.new(#ffb74d, 0)
cDim  = color.new(#78909c, 0)

var table panel = table.new(pos, 2, 11, bgcolor=cBg, frame_color=color.new(#5c6b8a, 0), frame_width=2, border_color=color.new(#2a3550, 0), border_width=1)

lblCell(r, t) =>
    table.cell(panel, 0, r, t, text_color=cLblT, bgcolor=cLbl, text_size=txtSz, text_halign=text.align_left)
valCell(r, t, tc) =>
    table.cell(panel, 1, r, t, text_color=tc, bgcolor=cBg, text_size=txtSz, text_halign=text.align_left)

if barstate.islast
    isL   = str.contains(status, "LONG")
    isS   = str.contains(status, "SHORT")
    sBg   = isL ? color.new(#00c853, 0) : isS ? color.new(#d50000, 0) : status == "DONE FOR TODAY" ? color.new(#000000, 0) : status == "SKIP" ? color.new(#37474f, 0) : color.new(#263238, 0)
    sTxt  = isL ? color.new(#000000, 0) : cTxt
    timeTxt = hhmm < countFrom ? "pre - no trades" : hhmm < aplusEnd ? "A+ window" : hhmm < normalEnd ? "Normal window" : "closed"
    rngCol  = na(rangeUsed) ? cDim : rangeUsed >= lineB ? cUp : rangeUsed >= lineA ? cMid : cDim
    longBias = e9 > e21
    pbOk  = (longBias and rsi5 < 50) or (not longBias and rsi5 > 50)

    table.cell(panel, 0, 0, "SIGNAL", text_color=cTxt, bgcolor=color.new(#1b2a4a, 0), text_size=txtSz, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 0, status,   text_color=sTxt, bgcolor=sBg, text_size=txtSz, text_halign=text.align_left)
    lblCell(1, "WHY")
    valCell(1, reason == "" ? "-" : reason, cTxt)
    lblCell(2, "CROSS #")
    valCell(2, nCross > maxCross ? "DONE (3rd+ cross)" : str.tostring(nCross) + " of " + str.tostring(maxCross), nCross > maxCross ? cDim : cTxt)
    lblCell(3, "RANGE")
    table.cell(panel, 1, 3, gauge(rangeUsed) + " " + fmt(rangeUsed) + "x  $" + fmt(dHi - dLo), text_color=rngCol, bgcolor=cBg, text_size=txtSz, text_halign=text.align_left, text_font_family=font.family_monospace)
    lblCell(4, "QQQ 9/21")
    valCell(4, qqqUp ? "UP" : "DOWN", qqqUp ? cUp : cDn)
    lblCell(5, "VWAP")
    valCell(5, (close > vwapR ? "above " : "below ") + fmt(close - vwapR), close > vwapR ? cUp : cDn)
    lblCell(6, "5m RSI")
    valCell(6, str.tostring(math.round(rsi5)) + (pbOk ? "  pullback ok" : "  confirmed"), pbOk ? cUp : cDim)
    lblCell(7, "TIME")
    valCell(7, timeTxt, hhmm >= normalEnd or hhmm < countFrom ? cDim : cTxt)
    lblCell(8, "ENTRY / STOP")
    valCell(8, na(pEntry) ? "-" : pSetup + "   E " + fmt(pEntry) + "   S " + fmt(pStop), cTxt)
    lblCell(9, "TARGETS")
    valCell(9, na(pEntry) ? "-" : "T1 " + fmt(pTp1) + "   T2 " + fmt(pTp2), cUp)
    lblCell(10, "DAILY ATR")
    valCell(10, "$" + fmt(dAtr) + "   A $" + fmt(lineA * dAtr) + "   B $" + fmt(lineB * dAtr), cTxt)
